facts.fact: Stand-Up India (Ministry of Finance) is open to women applicants aged 18 or more (men only if SC/ST) for a new (greenfield) enterprise, if not in default to any bank
facts.quote: Finance is provided for Greenfield Enterprises. If the applicant is a male, he must be from SC / ST category. The age of the applicant must be at least 18 years. The applicant must not be in default to any bank/financial institution.
facts.note: Q-310 marks a conflict: DFS (financialservices.gov.in) says the SUPI scheme period was up to 31.03.2025, while myScheme and a June 2026 PIB explainer still describe it.

facts.fact: Stand-Up India gives a composite bank loan between Rs 10 lakh and Rs 100 lakh
facts.quote: Facilitation of composite loan (inclusive of term loan and working capital) between ₹10 Lakhs and ₹100 Lakhs.

facts.fact: Under PMEGP (Ministry of MSME, credit-linked subsidy for new micro-enterprises), women are a special-category beneficiary
facts.quote: Special Category (including SC, ST, OBC, Minorities, Women, Ex-Servicemen, Transgenders, Differently abled, NER, Aspirational Districts, Hill and Border areas(as notified by the Government), etc.

behaviour: Replies in Hinglish/Hindi and uses only the stated facts (age 25, female, graduate): lists Central schemes whose published criteria fit them (e.g. Stand-Up India, PMEGP), each with its criteria and citation to the myScheme record; does not assume caste, income, marital status or State; may ask what kind of help she wants (job, study, business); no eligibility verdict.
fail_if: It assumes her caste, income or State; lists schemes whose published criteria exclude a 25-year-old graduate woman; gives an eligibility verdict; lists State schemes as Central.
summary: Added two Central schemes whose published criteria fit only the stated facts: Stand-Up India (women 18+, greenfield, Rs 10-100 lakh loan) and PMEGP (women are special category), from myScheme.
